title: The Complete DevOps Engineer Roadmap (Developer Fast-Track)
description: An intensive, realistic 8-month (32-week / 224-day) daily curriculum based on Mosh Hamedani's DevOps Roadmap, tailored for a software developer transitioning into DevOps.

modules.title: Linux Fundamentals & Bash Scripting

primary_book.title: The Linux Command Line (5th Internet Edition) / How Linux Works (3rd Ed.)
primary_book.author: William Shotts (Free at linuxcommand.org) & Brian Ward
primary_book.note: We read 1 short chapter (8-15 pages) per day—never overwhelming.

essential_concepts: Basic Linux commands, streams, pipes & redirection (ls, cp, mv, rm, find, xargs)
File system hierarchy (/, /home, /etc, /var, /proc, /sys, inodes, symlinks)
Permissions, ownership, SUID/SGID/Sticky bit & sudo (chmod, chown, umask)
Processes, signals, systemd services & resource inspection (ps, top, kill, lsof, journalctl)
Package management, archives & compression (apt, yum/dnf, tar, gzip)
Production Bash scripting (set -euo pipefail, variables, loops, conditionals, functions, traps, cron)
weekly_breakdown: Week 1 (Days 1-7): Shell internals, File System Hierarchy (FHS), Streams/Pipes, File Permissions & Ownership
Week 2 (Days 8-14): Processes, Signals, Systemd Services, Logs (journalctl), Disk/Memory & Package Management
Week 3 (Days 15-21): Text Processing (grep, sed, awk, jq) & Production-Grade Bash Automation Scripts

modules.title: Networking Concepts & Troubleshooting

primary_book.title: Computer Networking: A Top-Down Approach / Linux Pocket Guide (Networking sections)
primary_book.author: Kurose & Ross / Daniel J. Barrett
primary_book.note: Focused 10-page practical sections paired with Wireshark/tcpdump & CLI tools.

essential_concepts: OSI and TCP/IP models (L2 frames, L3 packets, L4 segments, 3-way handshake)
IP addressing, CIDR notation, subnetting (IPv4, IPv6, private subnets, NAT)
DNS resolution lifecycle and DHCP (dig, /etc/resolv.conf, record types)
Network protocols (HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2, HTTPS/TLS handshake, SSH & port forwarding)
Firewalls and security groups (iptables, UFW, nftables)
Network troubleshooting & packet capture (ping, traceroute/mtr, ss/netstat, nc, tcpdump, Wireshark)
weekly_breakdown: Week 4 (Days 22-28): TCP/IP vs OSI, IPv4/CIDR Subnetting, Routing, NAT, DNS & DHCP
Week 5 (Days 29-35): HTTP/TLS, SSH Tunneling, Host Firewalls (UFW/iptables) & Packet Troubleshooting (ss, tcpdump, Wireshark)

modules.title: Version Control (Git for DevOps & GitOps)

primary_book.title: Pro Git (2nd Edition - Free at git-scm.com/book)
primary_book.author: Scott Chacon & Ben Straub
primary_book.note: Fast-tracked for developers: focusing on Git internals, CI/CD branching workflows, hooks & recovery.

essential_concepts: Git object model internals (blobs, trees, commits, refs, HEAD)
Advanced branching, rebasing vs merging, cherry-picking & reflog recovery
Remote repositories, SSH signing, branch protection & CODEOWNERS (GitHub, GitLab)
Git workflows for DevOps (Trunk-Based Development, GitHub Flow, Git Flow)
Git hooks (pre-commit, pre-push) & Semantic Versioning tags for release pipelines
Complex merge conflict resolution & git bisect debugging
weekly_breakdown: Week 6 (Days 36-42): Git Internals, Trunk-Based vs GitFlow for CI/CD, Git Hooks, Bisect/Reflog & Release Tagging

modules.title: Programming Languages (Python for DevOps Automation)

primary_book.title: Python for DevOps
primary_book.author: Noah Gift, Kennedy Behrman, Alfredo Deza, Grig Gheorghiu
primary_book.note: Skipping beginner syntax; focusing 100% on OS automation, CLI building, APIs & infrastructure scripting.

essential_concepts: Pythonic data structures, comprehensions, generators & virtual environments (venv/uv)
File handling, pathlib, structured config parsing (YAML, JSON, TOML, env vars)
Robust error handling, logging module & retry patterns
System automation with subprocess, os, sys, shutil & signal handling
Building production CLI tools with argparse / click
HTTP APIs, webhooks & scraping (requests, BeautifulSoup, pagination, auth)
Cloud & infrastructure SDK basics (boto3 patterns)
weekly_breakdown: Week 7 (Days 43-49): File/OS Automation (pathlib, os, subprocess), Structured Configs (YAML/JSON) & Logging
Week 8 (Days 50-56): Building DevOps CLIs (argparse/click), REST API Automation (requests) & Mini Automation Project

modules.title: Cloud Providers (AWS Core Infrastructure)

primary_book.title: Amazon Web Services in Action (3rd Edition)
primary_book.author: Michael Wittig & Andreas Wittig
primary_book.note: Hands-on AWS architecture using AWS CLI + Free Tier / LocalStack.

essential_concepts: IAM (Users, Groups, Roles, JSON Policies, Least Privilege, AWS CLI & STS)
VPC Networking (VPCs, Public/Private Subnets, Route Tables, IGW, NAT Gateway, Security Groups vs NACLs)
EC2 (AMIs, Instance Types, SSH Keys, User Data, EBS Volumes, ALB & Auto Scaling Groups)
S3 (Buckets, Storage Classes, Bucket Policies, Versioning, Lifecycle Rules, Pre-signed URLs)
RDS (Multi-AZ vs Read Replicas, Subnet Groups, Backups, Security)
Lambda & Serverless (Functions, Execution Roles, Event Triggers, API Gateway)
CloudWatch (Metrics, Logs, Alarms, Billing Alerts) & Azure/GCP mental mapping
weekly_breakdown: Week 9 (Days 57-63): AWS Global Infra, IAM Deep Dive, AWS CLI & Security Best Practices
Week 10 (Days 64-70): VPC Networking from Scratch (Subnets, Routing, IGW, NAT, SGs, NACLs)
Week 11 (Days 71-77): Compute & Storage (EC2, EBS, Load Balancers, Auto Scaling, S3 Lifecycle & Policies)
Week 12 (Days 78-84): Managed Databases (RDS), Serverless (Lambda), CloudWatch Monitoring & Cloud Comparison (Azure/GCP)

modules.title: Containerization (Docker)

primary_book.title: Docker Deep Dive
primary_book.author: Nigel Poulton
primary_book.note: Short, punchy chapters covering container internals through production multi-container apps.

essential_concepts: Container internals (Linux namespaces, cgroups, overlayfs vs Virtual Machines)
Docker installation, daemon architecture & running/debugging containers
Creating & managing Docker images, layers & registries (Docker Hub, ECR, GHCR)
Dockerfile mastery (layer caching, multi-stage builds, non-root users, distroless/alpine, HEALTHCHECK)
Data persistence (managed volumes, bind mounts, tmpfs)
Container networking (bridge, host, none, user-defined networks & embedded DNS)
Docker Compose (multi-container orchestration, depends_on with healthchecks, networks, secrets)
weekly_breakdown: Week 13 (Days 85-91): Container Internals (Namespaces/cgroups), Docker CLI, Image Layers & Container Lifecycle
Week 14 (Days 92-98): Production Dockerfiles, Multi-Stage Builds, Image Optimization, Volumes & Container Networking
Week 15 (Days 99-105): Docker Compose Multi-Service Stacks, Image Vulnerability Scanning (Trivy) & Container Project

modules.title: Continuous Integration / Continuous Deployment (CI/CD)

primary_book.title: Continuous Delivery / Learning Continuous Integration with Jenkins
primary_book.author: Jez Humble & David Farley / Nikhil Pathania
primary_book.note: Covers both Jenkins (from roadmap) and GitHub Actions (modern industry standard).

essential_concepts: CI/CD concepts & principles (Continuous Integration vs Delivery vs Deployment)
Jenkins architecture, controller/agent setup & security credentials
Creating & configuring Jenkins pipelines (Declarative & Scripted Jenkinsfile)
Automated testing stages (unit, integration, linting, SAST security scans)
Build automation & Docker image packaging/pushing in pipelines
Modern CI/CD with GitHub Actions & GitLab CI (workflows, runners, matrix builds, OIDC)
Deployment automation strategies (Blue/Green, Canary, Rolling) & pipeline notifications
weekly_breakdown: Week 16 (Days 106-112): CI/CD Principles, Running Jenkins in Docker, Agents, Credentials & Declarative Jenkinsfiles
Week 17 (Days 113-119): Automated Testing, Linting, Docker Builds in Jenkins, Webhooks & Shared Libraries
Week 18 (Days 120-126): GitHub Actions / GitLab CI Pipelines, Deployment Strategies (Blue/Green, Canary) & End-to-End Pipeline

modules.title: Container Orchestration (Kubernetes & Helm)

primary_book.title: The Kubernetes Book / Kubernetes Up & Running
primary_book.author: Nigel Poulton / Brendan Burns, Joe Beda, Kelsey Hightower
primary_book.note: Hands-on local cluster labs using kind / minikube / k3s.

essential_concepts: Kubernetes architecture (Control Plane: API Server, etcd, Scheduler, Controller Manager; Worker Nodes: kubelet, kube-proxy)
Core components (Pods, ReplicaSets, Deployments, StatefulSets, DaemonSets, Jobs)
Managing resources (Namespaces, ConfigMaps, Secrets, Resource Requests/Limits, Probes)
Kubernetes networking (Services: ClusterIP, NodePort, LoadBalancer; Ingress Controllers; DNS)
Storage in Kubernetes (PV, PVC, StorageClasses) & Scaling (HPA - Horizontal Pod Autoscaler)
Helm basics (Charts, templates, values.yaml, releases, repositories)
Security in Kubernetes (RBAC: Roles/ClusterRoles/ServiceAccounts, NetworkPolicies, SecurityContexts)
weekly_breakdown: Week 19 (Days 127-133): K8s Architecture, Local Cluster Setup (kind/minikube), Pods, Deployments & kubectl Mastery
Week 20 (Days 134-140): Services, Ingress, ConfigMaps, Secrets, Namespaces & Liveness/Readiness Probes
Week 21 (Days 141-147): Persistent Storage (PV/PVC), StatefulSets, Resource Quotas, HPA Autoscaling & Troubleshooting
Week 22 (Days 148-154): Helm Package Manager (Charts/Templates/Releases), RBAC Security & NetworkPolicies

modules.title: Networking and Infrastructure Services (Nginx, Proxies, Caching)

primary_book.title: NGINX Cookbook (O'Reilly)
primary_book.author: Derek DeJonghe
primary_book.note: Practical recipes for reverse proxying, load balancing, TLS termination & caching.

essential_concepts: Forward proxies vs Reverse proxies
Setting up and configuring Nginx as a reverse proxy (server blocks, locations, proxy headers)
Load balancing with Nginx, HAProxy & AWS ALB (Round Robin, Least Connections, Health Checks)
SSL/TLS configuration, cipher suites, Let's Encrypt certificates & mTLS
Implementing caching layers with Redis and HTTP proxy caching (Nginx/Varnish)
Rate limiting, WAF basics, firewall hardening & production network troubleshooting
weekly_breakdown: Week 23 (Days 155-161): Forward vs Reverse Proxies, Nginx Configuration, Upstreams, Load Balancing & HAProxy
Week 24 (Days 162-168): SSL/TLS Termination, Let's Encrypt, Redis & HTTP Caching, Rate Limiting & Edge Troubleshooting

modules.title: Configuration Management (Ansible)

primary_book.title: Ansible for DevOps (2nd Edition)
primary_book.author: Jeff Geerling
primary_book.note: The gold-standard practical book on Ansible playbooks, roles, and testing.

essential_concepts: Configuration management principles (Idempotency, Agentless Push vs Agent Pull: Ansible vs Puppet/Chef)
Inventories (static INI/YAML & dynamic cloud inventories) and Ad-Hoc commands
Writing Ansible Playbooks (tasks, modules, handlers, notify, become)
Managing variables, facts, conditionals (when), loops & Jinja2 templates
Secrets management with Ansible Vault
Structuring reusable Roles, Collections & testing with Molecule
weekly_breakdown: Week 25 (Days 169-175): Idempotency, Inventories, Ad-Hoc Commands, Playbooks, Modules, Handlers & Variables
Week 26 (Days 176-182): Jinja2 Templates, Ansible Vault, Reusable Roles, Galaxy & Multi-Server Fleet Configuration

modules.title: Infrastructure as Code (Terraform)

primary_book.title: Terraform: Up & Running (3rd Edition)
primary_book.author: Yevgeniy Brikman
primary_book.note: Read 1 focused section per day; the definitive guide to production Terraform.

essential_concepts: IaC concepts (Declarative vs Imperative, Idempotency, Terraform vs CloudFormation)
Terraform basics (HCL syntax, providers, resources, data sources, variables, outputs)
Core lifecycle workflow (terraform init, fmt, validate, plan, apply, destroy)
Managing Terraform State (local vs remote state in S3, state locking, drift detection, import)
Reusable Terraform Modules (inputs, outputs, versioning, composition)
Advanced HCL (count, for_each, dynamic blocks, workspaces, policy checks)
weekly_breakdown: Week 27 (Days 183-189): IaC Principles, HCL Syntax, Providers, Resources, Variables, Outputs & Core CLI Workflow
Week 28 (Days 190-196): Terraform State Internals, Remote Backend (S3 + Locking), State Manipulation & Loops (for_each/count)
Week 29 (Days 197-203): Writing Reusable Modules, Workspaces, Multi-Environment Architecture & CloudFormation Comparison

modules.title: Monitoring, Logging & Final Capstone (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK)

primary_book.title: Prometheus: Up & Running (2nd Edition) & Site Reliability Engineering (Google SRE Book - Free)
primary_book.author: Julien Pivotto & Brian Brazil / Beyer et al.
primary_book.note: Combines hands-on Prometheus/Grafana/ELK setup with Google SRE observability principles.

essential_concepts: Observability fundamentals (Metrics, Logs, Traces; Four Golden Signals; RED/USE; SLIs/SLOs)
Prometheus architecture (pull model, scrape configs, metric types, node_exporter, service discovery)
PromQL (rate, irate, increase, histogram_quantile, aggregations) & Alertmanager
Grafana (data sources, dashboards, panels, variables, provisioning as code)
Centralized Logging with ELK Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash/Fluentd, Kibana) & Grafana Loki
End-to-End Production DevOps Capstone Project
weekly_breakdown: Week 30 (Days 204-210): SRE Golden Signals, Prometheus Setup, Exporters, Metric Types, PromQL & Alertmanager
Week 31 (Days 211-217): Grafana Dashboards-as-Code, Centralized Logging with ELK Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana)
Week 32 (Days 218-224): End-to-End DevOps Capstone (Terraform + Docker + Kubernetes + CI/CD + Prometheus/Grafana) & Interview Prep
